videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Hannah French presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Saturday Morning
videos.description: Tom Service has the perfect weekend classical soundtrack! Pianist Olga Pashchenko plays live on our studio piano, and Scottish mezzo Beth Taylor talks about her musical journey.

videos.title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
videos.description: Jools is joined by the author and film producer Olivia Harrison.

videos.title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
videos.description: 1889, Paris. After hearing Javanese gamelan at the Paris Exposition, Claude Debussy begins reimagining the possibilities of western classical music.

videos.title: Record Review
videos.description: Andrew McGregor with the best new classical releases, joined by Alice Farnham and Nigel Simeone, who surveys recordings of Rachmaninov's The Bells and makes a top recommendation.

videos.title: Sound of Cinema
videos.description: The best in film music and screen soundtracks, with Edith Bowman- this week composer Lorne Balfe joins Edith to talk about his score to the upcoming release of The Cat in the Hat.

videos.title: This Classical Life
videos.description: Jess Gillam is joined by the percussionist Joby Burgess for a listening party, including music by Peter Gabriel, Caroline Shaw, and Henryk Górecki.

videos.title: Opera on 3
videos.description: Peter Hoare stars as the drunken landlord catapulted to the moon and 15th-century Prague in Janácek's comic opera from the Bregenz Festival. Robert Jindra conducts.

videos.title: New Generation Artists
videos.description: A chance to hear specially recorded performances from Radio 3 New Generation Artists Lukas Sternath, the Leonkoro Quartet and baritone Andrew Hamilton.

videos.title: Music Planet
videos.description: Kathryn Tickell presents the best in global roots-based music, and members of Berlin-based band Mitsune share three tracks showcasing the Japanese shamisen.

videos.title: New Music Show
videos.description: Highlights from this week's event celebrating achievements in contemporary classical composition.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Stravinsky's 'Le Sacre du Printemps' and Bartók's Second Piano Concerto with the WDR Symphony Orchestra, Cologne and conductor Hannu Lintu.

videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Mark Forrest presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Sunday Morning
videos.description: Sarah Walker with three hours of classical music to reflect, restore and refresh whether you're out for a bracing walk or keeping cosy at home.

videos.title: Private Passions
videos.description: The fashion designer Paul Smith shares his musical passions with Michael Berkeley.

videos.title: Music Map
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch explores Ponchielli's 'Dance of the Hours' from his most famous opera, La Gioconda.

videos.title: Music Matters: The President and the Polka
videos.description: Justin Webb (Today and Americast presenter) explores the relationship between classical music and American political history. Today, the musical influence of immigrants and emigrés.

videos.title: Jazz Record Requests
videos.description: Alyn spins your requests, including a focus on saxophones & trumpets with music from Enrico Rava, Kim Cypher and Ronnie Scott, plus a jazz-orientated gem from Joni Mitchell.

videos.title: The Early Music Show
videos.description: Giovanni Antonini directs his ensemble Il Giardino Armonico in music by Vivaldi, Albinoni and Haydn at Melk Abbey on the banks of the River Danube in Austria.

videos.title: Choral Evensong
videos.description: A service from Blackburn Cathedral, with music by Ed Jones, Howells, Martin Bussey and Vierne.

videos.title: Between the Ears: Silent Teachers
videos.description: Composer Jay Capperauld creates a new work inspired by these 'silent teachers' the students who study them and the head anatomist who holds an annual service for their families.

videos.title: Sunday Feature: New Generation Thinkers shorts
videos.description: Novelist Yiyun Li, musician and Radio 3 Unwind host Niall Breslin and music historian Stacy Jarvis discuss the history and the revival of interest in nocturnes.

videos.title: Words and Music
videos.description: The season of Advent begins, a time of preparation and watchfulness in the liturgical calendar, and a time of year when we might look inward with a sense of possibility ahead.

videos.title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
videos.description: Hannah speaks to members of Cornwall's Porthleven Town Band who have gained a loyal fanbase on social media.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: Unclassified
videos.description: Elizabeth Alker picks new releases from the world of ambient music. Also, Stuart Murdoch of Belle and Sebastian is in the Listening Chair to select a track that transports him.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Lucile Boulanger directs the Consort Les Lucioles in this concert, which celebrates Purcell's 17th-century fantasias composed for the viola ensemble.

videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Tom McKinney presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Essential Classics
videos.description: Georgia Mann plays the best in classical music for your morning, with discoveries and surprises rubbing shoulders with familiar favourites.

videos.title: Classical Live
videos.description: Elizabeth Alker showcases live performance and exclusive concerts from home and abroad, including the Modigliani Quartet playing music by César Franck live in Wigmore Hall, London.

videos.title: Composer of the Week: Falla
videos.description: Kate Molleson explores Spanish composer Manuel de Falla's life in five cities, starting with his early years in Cádiz.

videos.title: In Tune
videos.description: Live music and interviews from the world's finest classical musicians.

videos.title: Classical Mixtape
videos.description: Take time out with a 30-minute soundscape of classical favourites, including music by Shostakovich, Chopin and Monnot.

videos.title: Radio 3 in Concert
videos.description: The BBC Scottish Symphony Orchestra performs with BBC New Generation Artist Oleg Shebeta-Dragan and conductor Kalena Bovell at Glasgow's City Halls.

videos.title: The Essay: Listening to the Planet
videos.description: Chris Watson meets elephant behaviour expert Joyce Poole to discover the extraordinary rumbles and trumpets of Kenya's elephants.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: 'Round Midnight
videos.description: Soweto hears from his guests from Monday to Thursday, Bristol founded group Tara Clerkin Trio. They are collectively sharing four of their best-loved jazz records, for 4/4.
